description_zh: 调用此API可根据筛选条件获取数据湖表分区列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-data-lake-partition-by-filter --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name test_table --filter ds_20241201 --next-token f056501ada12c1cc --max-results 20 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakePartitionByFilter

parameters.help_en: The region where the data lake resides
parameters.name: data_region

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

Find this ID by hovering over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en:
The conditional expression used to filter partitions. Supported operators include the following:

Comparison operators: =, <>, !=, <, <=, >, >=. Example: ds>20240101.

Logical operators: AND, OR, NOT. Example: ds LIKE '20240%'

BETWEEN operator: Specifies a range. Example: ds BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20241201.

IN operator: Specifies a set of values. Example: ds IN (20240101, 20240102)
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件表达式。支持如下运算符：

比较运算符：=、<>、!=、<、<=、>、>=。例如：ds>20240101。
逻辑运算符：AND、OR、NOT。例如：ds LIKE '20240%'
BETWEEN运算符：用于指定一个范围。例如：ds BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20241201。
IN 运算符：用于指定特定的值集合。例如：ds IN (20240101, 20240102)
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page of results. Values:

If NextToken is empty, no more pages exist.

If NextToken has a value, use it as the starting token for the next request
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results per page. Maximum: 100
parameters.name: max_results
